kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتأيرن (form IIq)
# نَتَأَيْرَنُ (nataʔayranu) /na.ta.ʔaj.ra.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# نَتَأَيْرَنَ (nataʔayrana) /na.ta.ʔaj.ra.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# نَتَأَيْرَنْ (nataʔayran) /na.ta.ʔaj.ran/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
